formula: effective_score = sum(w_i * score_i) / sum(w_i); w_i = base_i * (0.5 + gate_pass_rate_i) * (elo_i / 1500)
criteria: docs/ops/DECISION-MATRIX.md: Impact 1-5 x Importance 1-5 = score 1-25; bands P0 20-25, High 15-19, Medium 9-14, Backlog <=8
seed_note: Initial weights are neutral defaults (gate_pass_rate 0.5, elo 1500). The live state is the newest JSON comment on the 'Delphi panel weights ledger' issue; this file is only the cold-start default.
